title: Steampunk Serpent Sorceress
description: A woman with long flowing brown hair and steampunk goggles on her forehead stands centered, wearing an ornate high-collared leather and metal corset with visible gears. A large detailed snake with patterned scales is coiled around her torso and shoulders, its head raised near her chest as she gazes upward.
